races.name: Prestige Security Executive Protection Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Line Of Descent
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form who should track Alto Alto perfectly but carries 25 days since last run

runners_data.name: Begin The Luck
runners_data.note: Experienced prominent runner with trainer Daisy Hitchins in decent form but has never won on similar going

runners_data.name: Delgany Deadline
runners_data.note: Progressive prominent runner for in-form Dan Skelton with 3lb claimer but stepping up in grade significantly

runners_data.name: Alto Alto
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who will dictate from flag-fall but 34 days since last run may blunt his finishing kick

runners_data.name: Angel's Dream
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with 26lb weight advantage but faces wrong race shape and coming off disappointing recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Arrives below par, third of four here two weeks ago; tried in different headgear now
runners_data.spotlight: Gained a maiden success over fences at Lingfield (2m) in November 2024 but lightly raced since and below par, coming in only third of four over 2m1f here two weeks ago; tried in different headgear now.

races.paceDynamic: Alto Alto will lead this race uncontested from the start, with Line Of Descent, Begin The Luck, and Delgany Deadline all preferring prominent positions but none challenging for the early lead. The pace will be controlled and sustainable with Alto Alto setting his own fractions through the middle stages. Angel's Dream will need to overcome her hold-up style from the rear in a race where the front-runners can dictate terms. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and strike in the straight, as they'll be perfectly positioned behind an uncontested leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Alto Alto leads uncontested and the prominent trio settle well behind him
scenarios.body: The pace becomes very manageable allowing the prominent runners to travel smoothly before mounting late challenges. Line Of Descent, Begin The Luck and Delgany Deadline all benefit from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Steals Long Lead
scenarios.trigger: If Alto Alto builds an unassailable advantage while the prominent runners are content to let him go
scenarios.body: Alto Alto uses his front-running style to maximum effect, stealing crucial lengths that the field cannot recover. His class advantage at OR 105 tells when given these ideal conditions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Charge From Rear
scenarios.trigger: If Angel's Dream gets the perfect pace setup with a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace plays to Angel's Dream's hold-up style allowing her to use her finishing kick effectively. Her light weight of 142lbs becomes a crucial advantage in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners press Alto Alto early creating stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with multiple lead changes suiting the most adaptable horses. Begin The Luck's experience and Delgany Deadline's improving form become key factors.

watchPoints.text: Angel's Dream needs a strong pace from the start or her hold-up style becomes ineffective against this field composition
Begin The Luck has never won on good going despite multiple attempts which could be a significant obstacle
Delgany Deadline's inexperienced 3lb claimer Tristan Durrell faces his biggest test yet in race tactics
Alto Alto's 34-day break may affect his ability to sustain his front-running tactics over this trip
Line Of Descent's recent third at this track gives him course experience but 25 days off is borderline concerning

races.name: Mansell McTaggart Mane Event Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Loriko
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest OR 121 and solid recent hurdles form, jockey Durrell represents in-form Skelton stable

runners_data.name: Ballyeaston
runners_data.note: Prominent runner likely to lead, 45-day break not ideal but Harry Skelton booking suggests confidence from champion stable

runners_data.name: Oblemenko
runners_data.note: Hold-up type making hurdles debut for Moore stable, low OR 89 but unexposed over obstacles

runners_data.name: Shutfrontdoor
runners_data.note: Prominent style with useful recent form including course win, benefits from 7lb weight allowance via claiming jockey

runners_data.name: Giddyupadingdong
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with modest OR 68 but won last time out, likely needs significant improvement in this grade

runners_data.name: Moon Monarch
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 428-day absence, Cobden booking suggests connections expect improvement
runners_data.comment: Booking of Harry Cobden suggests a bigger effort may be on the way; reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Showed some promise in bumpers but hasn't fared so well in two attempts over hurdles, latest 14 months ago; however, booking of Harry Cobden suggests a bigger effort may be on the way.

runners_data.name: Khalk'eau Spigao
runners_data.note: Hold-up 4-year-old making hurdles debut, light weight but unproven at this level

runners_data.name: Versatile
runners_data.note: Hold-up type switching from Flat racing, question marks over hurdles ability but OR 120 suggests some talent

races.paceDynamic: Ballyeaston will take the field along from the front with his prominent style, likely joined by Shutfrontdoor early if connections are aggressive. With most of the field preferring to hold up (Loriko, Oblemenko, Giddyupadingdong, Khalk'eau Spigao, Versatile), the pace should be honest but not frantic in this 8-runner maiden. The concentration of hold-up horses means the tempo will be sustainable until the business end, where those tracking will need the race to develop into a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can time their challenge, particularly those with the class to quicken when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays honest and the field remains bunched turning for home
scenarios.body: Ballyeaston sets a steady tempo allowing the back-markers to get into contention, with the race becoming a test of who has the most class and finishing kick from off the pace. Loriko's superior OR 121 and proven hurdles form gives him the edge over his hold-up rivals.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front-Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If Ballyeaston and Shutfrontdoor dictate terms and kick clear approaching the last
scenarios.body: The prominent pair get first run and maintain their advantage to the line, with the hold-up horses unable to reel them in despite their class edge. Shutfrontdoor's 7lb weight advantage and recent winning form proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early tempo is too slow and it becomes a messy sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace-pressure allows every horse to stay in contention, turning it into a lottery where positioning and luck matter more than class. Any of the prominent runners or those who can get a forward position benefit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Ballyeaston Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Ballyeaston gets an uncontested lead and kicks away from the last hurdle
scenarios.body: The 6-year-old gets his own way in front throughout and has enough in reserve to resist late challenges, with his hurdles experience proving crucial. None of the hold-up horses can mount a serious challenge.

watchPoints.text: Ballyeaston gets an uncontested lead and dictates the race throughout, as most rivals prefer to come from behind
Loriko gets shuffled back too far given his hold-up style in a race that may not develop into a strong gallop
Moon Monarch shows signs of a big run after his long absence, with Harry Cobden's presence suggesting stable confidence
The pace becomes too sedate early with so many hold-up horses, turning the finish into a messy sprint where anything can happen
Versatile adapts well to hurdles on debut having shown ability on the Flat with OR 120

runners_data.name: Moveit Like Minnie

runners_data.name: Elysian Knight
runners_data.note: Prominent type who could benefit from sustainable pace, pulled-up last time raises stamina questions, headgear first-time

runners_data.name: Turndlightsdownlow

runners_data.name: Bethpage

runners_data.name: Roger Pol
runners_data.note: Classy hold-up horse returning from 190-day layoff after autumn double, 5lb claimer helpful but long absence major concern

runners_data.name: Tranquil Sea
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who has been disappointing lately, tongue-tie and pull-strap headgear changes suggest issues, lowest weight helps

runners_data.name: Top Guy
runners_data.note: Progressive hold-up type with recent Newton Abbot win showing stamina, 15 days since last run ideal spacing, strong upward trajectory
runners_data.comment: Broadly progressive form since November; scored readily at Newton Abbot last time
runners_data.spotlight: Broadly progressive form since November features two wins, including at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) latest start when doing it readily; may continue to improve; one to consider, despite going up a further 10lb and Harry Skelton preferring stablemate Tranquil Sea.

runners_data.name: Fountains Blenhein
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner who will dictate pace, consistent record at trip and going, needs to handle increased competition level

races.paceDynamic: Fountains Blenhein will control proceedings from the front, with East India Express, Moveit Like Minnie, Elysian Knight and Turndlightsdownlow forming the prominent pack behind. The sustainable pace set by Fountains Blenhein won't come under serious pressure until late, allowing the hold-up horses to get into contention. With six hold-up horses including Double Powerful, Kamsinas, Bethpage, Roger Pol, Tranquil Sea and Top Guy, the race sets up for a cavalry charge finish. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can quicken from off the pace in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains sustainable throughout and the hold-up brigade gets into the race
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows closers to position perfectly before unleashing their finishing kicks in the final half-mile. Top Guy, Double Powerful and Roger Pol benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Stays
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners maintains their position and outstays the field
scenarios.body: Turndlightsdownlow or Moveit Like Minnie could prove too tough in the closing stages if the hold-up horses don't quicken quickly enough. Their forward position gives them first run on the leaders.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire Job
scenarios.trigger: If Fountains Blenhein gets an uncontested lead and stays strong
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Fountains Blenhein to dictate completely and potentially steal the race if the chasers leave it too late. His recent form suggests he has the stamina for this longer trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes extremely slow and turns into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure speed test in the final furlong, potentially suiting an unexposed horse or one with natural pace. This scenario least likely given the trip and field composition.

watchPoints.text: Roger Pol returning from 190-day absence could be ring-rusty despite strong autumn form and needs close market monitoring
Kamsinas and Tranquil Sea both sport headgear changes suggesting recent issues that could impact performance
Fountains Blenhein's early pace-setting will be crucial - if allowed easy lead he becomes dangerous to all
East India Express needs to bounce back from recent poor form but amateur rider claims valuable 7lbs
Top Guy's 15-day turnaround from Newton Abbot win suggests connections confident in his wellbeing and progression

races.name: Weatherbys nhstallions.co.uk Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Northern Poet
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer whose excellent recent form (two wins) gives him leading claims despite the 51-day break

runners_data.name: Sea Invasion
runners_data.note: Prominent runner well-suited to the likely pace scenario with Twiston-Davies an advantage over this trip

runners_data.name: Lumi Plugin
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needing everything to fall right but has shown decent form recently for in-form Moore stable

runners_data.name: Morfee
runners_data.note: Another hold-up runner whose high RPR of 126 suggests he has the class to be competitive if getting the right race shape

runners_data.name: Enjoy d'Allen
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose stamina credentials are solid, though the 7lb claimer is a slight concern at this level

runners_data.name: Roe And Co
runners_data.note: The likely pace-setter returning from a 98-day break after bleeding from nose last time, but previous form excellent
runners_data.comment: Landed a three-timer in November/December but was pulled up at Fontwell in January.
runners_data.spotlight: Landed a three-timer in November/December but was pulled up on soft when favourite at Fontwell (3m2f) in January when he was reported to have bled from the nose; returns from a break and needs to hit the ground running to get back on track.

races.paceDynamic: Roe And Co will set the pace uncontested from the start, with Sea Invasion and Enjoy d'Allen likely to track just behind in the early stages. The lack of genuine pace pressure means this will be run at a steady gallop for the first two miles before quickening from the back straight. With four hold-up horses (Northern Poet, Lumi Plugin, Morfee) relying on the race coming back to them late, and only one confirmed front-runner, this tactical setup strongly favours those who can position prominently and have the stamina to sustain a long run from 3-4 furlongs out.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Suits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Roe And Co sets an honest but manageable gallop and the prominent runners get first run
scenarios.body: Sea Invasion and Enjoy d'Allen can position perfectly behind the leader and have enough left to resist the late challengers. The hold-up horses face too much ground to make up over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Roe And Co's class tells and the extended break has freshened him up sufficiently
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate terms throughout and prove too strong when the challenges come, especially with his previous winning form over similar trips. His bleeding issue from last time may have been a one-off.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Kick Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is particularly steady and Morfee or Northern Poet produce their best form
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses can close the gap in the straight when others tire over this stamina-sapping distance. Northern Poet's excellent recent form and Morfee's high RPR suggest they have the quality.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lumi Plugin Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the race sets up perfectly for a back-marker with Caoilin Quinn timing the challenge to perfection
scenarios.body: The Moore-trained runner can use superior finishing speed to pick off tiring leaders in the final furlong. His recent placed form suggests he's close to a win.

watchPoints.text: Monitor Roe And Co early - if he travels poorly or shows any signs of the breathing issues that affected him last time
Watch Sea Invasion's position turning in - needs to be handy to capitalise on his prominent running style in this small field
Observe Northern Poet's jumping rhythm - his hold-up style means he cannot afford any errors with limited recovery time
Check Enjoy d'Allen's handling of the pace - Miss Jones's 7lb claim is helpful but she needs to judge the tempo correctly
Note Lumi Plugin's position at halfway - if too far back in this small field he may struggle to make up the ground

races.name: Diane And Harry's Plumpton Annual Box Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Market House

runners_data.comment: Good second here two weeks ago; must enter calculations up 1lb in a change of headgear
runners_data.spotlight: On a losing run but he has been running well on the Flat and returned to hurdling with a good second of eight in 2m4f handicap here two weeks ago; must enter calculations nudged up 1lb in a change of headgear.

runners_data.name: Answer That
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needs strong pace and clear run, mixed recent form but Chris Gordon's 3/15 strike rate offers some confidence

runners_data.name: Shalfa
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner will dictate throughout, recent win at this track is key form, Marc Goldstein booking suggests stable confidence

runners_data.name: Fascinating Lips

runners_data.name: Chartwell Jock

runners_data.name: Alibey

runners_data.name: Lord Of The Glance

runners_data.name: Banksman
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from long absence but carries bottom weight, previous course form gives him each-way claims

runners_data.name: Dissident

runners_data.name: Mystical Mabel

races.paceDynamic: Shalfa stands as the only confirmed front runner and will dictate from the off without early pressure. Market House and Alibey may track prominently but won't challenge Shalfa's early lead, allowing a sustainable gallop through the first circuit. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Answer That, Lord Of The Glance, Dissident, and Fascinating Lips will be bunched at the rear, creating a congested finish as they all make late moves. This pace scenario strongly favours the front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic and benefit from Shalfa's honest pace-making.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Shalfa gets an easy lead and stays on strongly up the hill
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Shalfa to control the race and kick clear when it matters. Market House may challenge but the leader's tactical advantage proves decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Market House or Alibey can track the leader and pounce late
scenarios.body: The prominent horses get first run on the tiring leader while avoiding the hold-up traffic behind. Their forward position gives them a crucial edge over the back markers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field comes back to the closers
scenarios.body: A slow early gallop allows the hold-up horses to close the gap and one class act gets through the traffic. Lord Of The Glance's recent form makes him the most likely beneficiary.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos In Running
scenarios.trigger: If Shalfa goes too fast early or there's significant interference
scenarios.body: An unsustainable gallop or traffic problems opens the door for an outsider with luck in running. Banksman's lightweight and fresh condition could prove decisive.

watchPoints.text: Shalfa could get loose on the lead if no prominent horses go with him early, making him very hard to peg back
Traffic problems highly likely with seven hold-up horses all needing room in the straight - watch for interference
Market House's jumping under pressure as he returns to hurdles after flat racing - any mistake could prove costly
Lord Of The Glance needs a strong pace to be effective but may get caught behind horses if Shalfa goes too slow
Both Moore runners Dissident and Mystical Mabel could improve significantly for their recent runs but need everything to fall right

races.name: Kalm Club Keep Calm & Gallop On Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Oakley's Way
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid Plumpton form who should get a perfect tactical position behind the expected pace battle.
runners_data.comment: Latest effort took his record at 2m3f-2m5f to 122; may do better still; solid claims
runners_data.spotlight: Solid record in 2m3f-2m5f attempts comprises an account-opening success at Taunton (good to firm) in November and second-place finishes, including at Plumpton, in last two starts; may do better still at this sort of distance; solid claims.

runners_data.name: Hecouldbetheone
runners_data.note: Natural leader with proven course form, but faces genuine pace pressure from Goodwin which may compromise his stamina reserves.
runners_data.comment: Won this contest off 5lb higher 12 months ago; fighting chance if back in similar form
runners_data.spotlight: Spell over fences featured two wins last June; unable to take advantage of drop to selling level back over hurdles last time but won this contest off 5lb higher 12 months ago (admittedly beat only two rivals) and has a fighting chance provided he's back in similar form.

runners_data.name: Notnowlinda
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up performer wearing cheekpieces after encouraging Uttoxeter third, ideally positioned for the expected strong gallop.
runners_data.comment: Showed major signs of a revival in first-time cheekpieces most recently; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Skelton mare who showed major signs of a revival in first-time cheekpieces at Uttoxeter (2m4f) most recently, finishing a close third; remains 3lb below the mark she defied at Hereford (2m) two years ago; warrants respect in the retained headgear.

runners_data.name: Hiconic
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 231-day layoff which raises immediate fitness concerns despite trainer's positive strike rate.

runners_data.name: Alien Storm
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up horse with highest official rating who should benefit significantly from the anticipated honest pace scenario.

runners_data.name: Goodwin
runners_data.note: Front runner whose recent inconsistency raises questions about his ability to sustain a pace battle over this demanding trip.

runners_data.name: The Bellhop
runners_data.note: Four-year-old hold-up specialist with proven stamina credentials who can capitalise if the pace develops as expected.

races.paceDynamic: Goodwin and Hecouldbetheone will contest the early lead in this small field, with both confirmed front runners likely to engage from the start. Their pace duel should create an honest gallop over this stamina-testing 2m4½f trip at Plumpton, with the tempo unlikely to slacken significantly given their natural racing styles. The hold-up horses Alien Storm, Notnowlinda and The Bellhop will track behind the pace-setters, while prominent runners Oakley's Way and Hiconic settle in the middle order. This sustained gallop strongly favours the hold-up performers who can finish fastest when the early leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Goodwin and Hecouldbetheone engage in a proper pace battle from flagfall.
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop over this demanding trip will set up perfectly for the closers to sweep past tiring leaders in the final half-mile. Alien Storm and Notnowlinda can time their challenges to perfection from their patient positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner survives duel
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can gain a crucial advantage and kick clear approaching the final flight.
scenarios.body: Hecouldbetheone's proven stamina at this trip gives him the edge over Goodwin in a sustained battle, allowing him to find extra when the closers mount their challenge. His previous course win adds significant confidence.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the race becomes tactical from halfway.
scenarios.body: Oakley's Way can position perfectly in the reduced tempo, using his tactical speed to strike decisively when the race develops in the closing stages. His recent Plumpton second-place finish proves he handles the track conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate pace suits all
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders settle more conservatively than their natural styles suggest.
scenarios.body: The race becomes more evenly contested throughout, allowing several runners to remain competitive deep into the home straight. Form horses can prevail without the extreme tactical bias toward any specific running style.

watchPoints.text: Hiconic faces a massive fitness test returning from an 8-month absence despite his prominent racing style suiting the likely pace.
Goodwin's recent form shows alarming inconsistency and he may crack quickly if forced into an early pace battle with Hecouldbetheone.
The Bellhop carries a 3lb claimer in Freddie Mitchell which could prove decisive if the race develops into a tight finish.
Alien Storm's 7lb claiming jockey Daire McConville faces a tactical challenge positioning the hold-up horse in this small field.
Track the early fractions between Goodwin and Hecouldbetheone as their pace battle will determine the entire race shape.

runners_data.name: Skye Glance

runners_data.name: Steal A Glance

runners_data.spotlight: Out of a bumper/hurdle winner for her yard; faded into midfield at Wincanton, failing to back up her close second at Ludlow, but this looks weaker and she may yet progress; shortlist material.

runners_data.name: Golden Sanjida
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits this tactical setup, headgear applied and 32-day freshening break

races.paceDynamic: Posh Chick will likely lead or share the early pace with fellow prominent runners Skye Glance and Steal A Glance, creating a moderate tempo over this stamina-testing 2m2f trip. The small seven-runner field and lack of genuine speed horses suggests a steady gallop that won't stretch the field early, allowing hold-up horses like Mirabello and Golden Sanjida to stay in touch. The pace will intensify from three furlongs out as the prominent trio engage, but the moderate early fractions mean stamina will prove decisive in the final furlong. This tactical setup clearly favours horses with proven staying power and finishing kicks over those dependent on front-running tactics.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Posh Chick sets honest fractions and the pace stays strong throughout
scenarios.body: The genuine tempo plays to proven stayers who can quicken off a solid pace rather than pure speed horses. Mirabello and Golden Sanjida benefit from their hold-up styles as the early pace-setters weaken.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Posh Chick gets soft fractions and isn't pressured by the prominent runners early
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows the leader to save energy for a strong finish, with Steal A Glance tracking and pouncing. Early positioning proves crucial as hold-up horses struggle to make ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If all the prominent runners mark each other and create a slowly-run race
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns this into a sprint finish where tactical speed matters more than stamina. The lightly-raced newcomers Cheese and Silver Whisper could have untapped speed for such a finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Skye Glance's known finishing weakness spreads to other prominent runners and they all fade
scenarios.body: The honest early pace set by multiple prominent runners creates a war of attrition where none finish strongly. Golden Sanjida's hold-up style and fresher profile allows her to pick up the pieces late.

watchPoints.text: Posh Chick if she gets uncontested lead early - previous win came from ideal position and she could repeat
Skye Glance's jumping out of the gates - needs to be handy early as her finishing kick consistently fails
Mirabello's attitude after being tailed off last time - any signs of reluctance would confirm something amiss
Silver Whisper and Cheese for market moves - both unknowns but strong jockey bookings suggest hidden ability
Golden Sanjida's early positioning - needs to be closer than usual given the likely modest pace
